# Bankové nástroje pre účtovníkov: jedna Pro licencia pre tri nástroje

Live: https://arling.sk/bankove-nastroje/

A bundle page (static HTML, no build step) that sells one Pro licence
for three of the four free, client-side ARLing tools Slovak accountants use for
bank files (SEPA pain.001 Doctor has no Pro tier and needs no licence). This page itself does not process any payment data: it only
sells and manages the licence key that the three tools with Pro check.

## Why this exists

Each of the four tools below already works on its own, for free and with no account: checking pain.001 files is free and building them is free up to 5,000 payments per file, while camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb download only the first 20 rows without a licence. As their number grew, buying and managing a
separate paid tier per tool became friction for anyone using more than
one of them regularly (most accountants who need one of these need at
least two: a payment file generator and a bank-statement reader, say).
This page turns that into a single purchase, a single key, and a single
place to manage it.

## The four tools

1. **SEPA pain.001 Doctor**: https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-doctor/
   Checks a finished `pain.001.001.03` XML batch payment file against the
   bank-specific rules of Tatra banka, Slovenská sporiteľňa (SLSP), VÚB,
   and ČSOB (IBAN/BIC, amounts, transaction counts and sums, VS/ŠS/KS
   symbols, character set) before you import it into internet banking.

2. **SEPA pain.001 Generátor**: https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/
   Builds a `pain.001.001.03` XML batch payment file from payments pasted
   or uploaded from Excel or CSV. Every generated file is checked
   automatically by the same engine as SEPA pain.001 Doctor.

3. **camt.053 do Excelu**: https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/
   Converts a `camt.053` XML bank statement (Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB,
   ČSOB) into a CSV or Excel table: date, signed amount, counterparty,
   VS/ŠS/KS, and an opening/closing balance check.

4. **Párovač platieb**: https://arling.sk/parovac-platieb/
   Matches a `camt.053` bank statement against a list of issued invoices
   (pasted or uploaded from Excel/CSV) and sorts the result into paid,
   unpaid, overpaid, and unmatched, even when the variabilný symbol
   doesn't line up exactly.

All four run entirely in the browser: no backend, no upload of your
payment data, no account.

## What Pro adds, in the Generator, camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb

- **Saved payer profiles**: company name, IBAN, BIC, bank, picked from a
  list instead of retyped every time (Generátor, Párovač).
- **Multiple files or accounts at once**: several payment batches, bank
  statements, or accounts processed together instead of one at a time.
- **Column-mapping templates** for exports from Pohoda (Stormware),
  Omega (KROS), and Money S3 (Seyfor), on top of each tool's own
  free-tier auto-detection.
- **History**: the last processing runs in each of these three tools, stored locally in
  the browser, with re-download where applicable.
- **Priority email support.**

Checking and building pain.001 files stays free, with no cap on the number of files or downloads; one generated file holds at most 5,000 payments, whether or not you have Pro. In camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb the conversion and matching are free on the whole file, but without a licence the downloaded file holds the first 20 rows as a sample, and the MT940 and DATEV exports are Pro. Pro is convenience for
someone who runs one or more of these tools every month, not a
requirement for the core functionality of any of them.

## Pricing

- 9 EUR / month, or
- 79 EUR / year (29 EUR less than paying monthly for 12 months).

VAT included in the price. The licence is sold through Stripe Managed
Payments. The merchant of record is Link (Sold through Link, LLC), which
sends the receipt and the invoice as a PDF; Stripe calculates and remits
the VAT. ARLing s. r. o. delivers the tools and the licence key. Cancel
at any time in the Stripe customer portal
(https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/3cIaER9M63hNeFcg8B4ko00, log in with
the e-mail you paid with); the licence stays active until the end of the
paid period and the next period is not charged. A monthly or yearly
subscription is refunded on request within 14 days of purchase, without
giving a reason (support@arling.sk). Terms:
https://arling.sk/podmienky/en/ (sections 4 to 6).

## How the licence works

After payment, this page requests a signed licence (an Ed25519 signature
over a small JSON payload carrying the plan `"sepa-pro"` and an expiry
date) from ARLing's licence service and stores it in the browser's
`localStorage`. Verification happens entirely client-side with the
browser's WebCrypto API; there is no server call on ordinary use after
that, and no account or login is involved.

Because this bundle page and the three tools with Pro are served from the same
origin (`arling.sk`), a licence key saved by any one of them is already
visible to the others via shared `localStorage`, nothing extra to
configure. If that doesn't happen automatically (a different browser, or
site data cleared), the same key can be pasted manually into the Licencia
section of this page, or directly into any of the three tools with Pro.

SEPA pain.001 Generátor also still accepts its own older, tool-specific
plan for customers who bought Pro on that tool alone before this bundle
existed; both plans keep working side by side, so nobody who already
paid loses access.

## Who it's for

Slovak accountants, bookkeepers, and company directors who use at least
two of the four tools above on a recurring basis (for example: generate
a payment file, then later read the bank statement back and match it
against invoices) and want one licence and one bill instead of three.

## Privacy

- No account, no login, no cookies beyond what this page itself needs to
  manage the licence.
- No server-side processing of bank data anywhere across the four tools;
  each one's own conversion or check runs in your browser.
- Analytics (self-hosted Umami) record anonymous usage counts (page
  view, which plan was bought), never the content of what you process in
  any of the four tools.
- The only exception is the optional mailing-list form: if you type an
  email address into it, that address is sent to the subscribe endpoint
  and nothing else.

## FAQ

**Do I have to buy the bundle to use any of the four tools?**
No. Every tool has a free tier independent of this page: checking pain.001 files is free, building them is free up to 5,000 payments per file, and camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb convert and match the whole file for free but download only the first 20 rows without a licence. The bundle is worth it once you use at least two of the tools
regularly; for occasional use of a single tool, the free tier is enough.

**I already bought Pro on SEPA pain.001 Generátor alone. Does buying the
bundle replace that, or do I need both?**
You don't need both. Your existing Generátor-only licence keeps working
there for as long as it's valid; buying the bundle instead gives you one
key that also works in camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb. There's no need to cancel
anything to switch.

**What happens across a device I haven't opened any of the tools on
before?**
Open the Licencia section of this page (or the Pro section of any of the
three tools with Pro) and paste the licence key you received by email after
payment. No account or login is required on the new device.
